turns.text: And why has online shopping become so popular in your particular country?
turns.zh: 那为什么网购在你们国家这么火呢？

turns.text: It can be quite overwhelming in a place like India in the big cities to kind of go through all the the stores.
turns.zh: 在像印度这样的大城市里，你要逛遍所有的商店，真的会让人挺吃不消的。

turns.text: It's a lot of stimulus and it takes a lot of effort to do it because there's a lot of people and it's a lot of interaction with people.
turns.zh: 刺激太多了，而且做这件事要费很大劲，因为人很多，要跟很多人打交道。

turns.text: It's a little bit noisy and it's you know um So, I think our generation we're a bit uh Mm.
turns.zh: 有点吵，而且你知道吧，嗯……所以我觉得我们这一代人有点……嗯。

turns.text: I don't want to say introverted, but we like uh uh uh personal space a little bit more.
turns.zh: 我不想说内向，但我们确实更喜欢一点个人空间。

turns.text: So, just the convenience of having being able to click things on a screen and have it shipped to your house and not having to interact with people is very enticing.
turns.zh: 所以，只要在屏幕上点一点，东西就送到家，不用跟人打交道，这种便利真的很有吸引力。

turns.text: So, um for those reasons I think people prefer to buy things online more than in store.
turns.zh: 所以，嗯，因为这些原因，我觉得人们更喜欢网购而不是去实体店买。

turns.text: Are there any possible disadvantages of the growth of online shopping?
turns.zh: 那网购的增长有没有什么可能的缺点呢？
